|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Mist Hunter (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Mist Hunter (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The remastered slip changes the opposing destiny penalty from 3 to 2 and prints attrition immunity below 3 without the Zuckuss condition. It omits the ship-docking clause, keeping the capacity, free deployment and ability to reduce opposing weapon, battle and asteroid destiny while Zuckuss pilots. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=85 Period ship-docking capability].
